title: spec(stack): `forEachPageComponent` never visits a `page:tabs` item's `children`, so `defineStack`'s page cross-reference checks (inline action targets, inline grid columns) do not judge anything placed inside tabs
body:
**Filing gate ①**, class (a): a defect with a named landing and a measured wrong result.
- **`reach:`** the public door `defineStack` (and so `os validate`). The #24190 dev ran a probe through `defineStack` on branch `claude/issue-24190-line-items-hydrated-check` (head `af540b850`). An inline action with `type: 'modal'` and a dangling `target`, placed under a `page:tabs` item's `children`, builds green. The same button at region level is refused: `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` 422, "references page 'no_such_modal_xyz' (via modal target) which is not defined in pages". The identity-only `scale` column is accepted the same way under tabs, for both `record:line_items` and `object-master-detail-form`, and refused at region level.
- **Named producer:** `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/project-detail.page.ts`. Its `record:line_items` block sits under a `page:tabs` item's `children` (the `tasks` tab), so the page walk never reaches it.

**Filed by** `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_019oFY6Hi35J7atvgVFnmoaK`, from the #24190 dev's `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (PR #24347). The seat verified the walk below. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade follow the filer exception and the grading rule cited below; triage may change either.

## Measured on `origin/main` `68a090fb97` (the walk is unchanged at the current head)

- `forEachPageComponent` (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:2405`) visits `regions[].components[]` and `slots.NAME`. From each node, it recurses into any array under `properties` whose entries are component-shaped (`isComponentNode`).
- A `page:tabs` node's `properties.items` is an array of `{ value, label, children }` (`PageTabsProps`, `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:814`). An item is not component-shaped, so the walk never descends into `items[].children`.
- The walk's own docblock says it "reaches every container spelling without this walk enumerating them" (`stack.zod.ts:2403`), and the inline-action check says "The traversal is {@link forEachPageComponent}'s: every root, every nesting" (`:2458`). Both are false for tabs.
- Its callers: the inline-action cross-reference check (`:2479`, #6889) and the inline grid column check (`:3638`, #20928; PR #24347 adds the `record:line_items` carrier there).

## The work

One PR on `packages/spec`:

- Make `forEachPageComponent` reach every component a page carries, including a `page:tabs` item's `children`. Prefer a rule that follows the declared container shapes over one that adds a special case only for tabs. First enumerate every declared prop shape that carries components one level down, through an item record, and cover each one.
- Pins: a dangling inline-action target and an identity-only `scale` column under a tabs item are refused, with the same message as at region level. The showcase project detail page still builds (or the PR names what it now refuses and fixes it).
- This narrows what `defineStack` publishes: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, with a contract-tier review before the queue, and an ADR-0087 disposition in the changeset.
- Check whether `@objectstack/lint`'s page walks (the component-props gate) have the same gap, and say so in the PR. Fix it in the same PR only if it is the same walk.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:spec` seat, one PR. `stack.zod.ts` carries #24190's PR #24347 until it lands: dispatch after it.

## Grade

p1 + `target:v18` under the protocol-class rule (a fix that changes what `defineStack` accepts, in either direction). Triage may regrade.

## Dedupe

Two semantic searches of this repository's issues:
- "forEachPageComponent page:tabs items children not visited cross-reference": 0 hits.
- "defineStack inline action modal target under tabs not validated": 8 hits, all closed. The nearest is #6889, which added the inline-action walk and did not cover tabs. The others are about skills text, action shapes and the console.

Dedupe words: forEachPageComponent page:tabs items children; inline action dangling target page:tabs defineStack; cross-reference page walk tabs items not visited.
